phrases.english: I need a room, for one night.
phrases.tamil: ஒரு இரவு, எனக்கு ஒரு அறை வேண்டும்.
phrases.transliteration: oru iravu, enakku oru arai vendum.

phrases.english: My older brother, he is smart.
My younger sister, she is playful.
Every word learned, a new world opens.
phrases.tamil: கற்ற ஒவ்வொரு சொல்லும், ஒரு புதிய உலகம் திறக்கும்.
phrases.transliteration: Katrra ovvoru sollum, oru puthiya ulagam thirakkum.

phrases.english: Embrace the language, find your voice.
Try it, you might like it.
Believe in yourself, you can do it.
Just a moment, I'll be there.
You are stronger than you think.
Imagine new worlds, then build them.
phrases.tamil: புதிய உலகங்களை கற்பனை செய், பிறகு உருவாக்கு.
phrases.transliteration: puthiya ulagangaḷai kaṟpaṉai cey, piṟaku uruvākku.

phrases.english: Your ideas matter, let them flow.
We want a table, for two.
phrases.tamil: எங்களுக்கு ஒரு டேபிள் வேணும், ரெண்டு பேருக்கு.
phrases.transliteration: Engalukku oru table venum, rendu perukku.

phrases.english: Can I see the menu, please?
I want to be with you.
Don't fear mistakes, learn from them.
Do you have this, in red?
You are stronger, than you think.
Fire! There is a fire, quickly!
I am lost, can you help?
Every second counts, use it wisely.
Patience is key, wait for the right moment.

phrases.tamil: ஒரு அடி எடுத்து வை, பிறகு இன்னொன்று.
phrases.transliteration: Oru adi eduthu vai, piragu innondru.

phrases.english: Every day, is a new chance.
Make time for what matters most.
The clock is ticking, let's begin.
Seize the moment, create your future.
Time heals all wounds, be patient.
phrases.tamil: காலம் எல்லா காயங்களையும் ஆற்றும், பொறுமையாக இருங்கள்.
phrases.transliteration: Kaalam ellaa kaayangalaiyum aatrum, porumaiyaga irungal.

phrases.english: The bill, can I get it?
My cousin, he is a friend.
Create with passion, share with joy.
Design with purpose, live with flair.
Make something new, make it shine.
phrases.tamil: புதிதாக ஒன்றை செய், அதை பிரகாசிக்க வை.
phrases.transliteration: putitāka oṉṟai cey, atai pirakācikka vai.

phrases.english: You can do this, believe it.
This means a lot, thank you.
